'''Spaceport Speeders''' was a [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] shop in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The business rented, sold, and bought [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] and [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]].<ref name="Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref>

Most of the speeders available to buy were older and not well-maintained and the proprietor was known for buying his stock at a price far below the speeders' fair market value. For this reason, most of Tatooine's farmers bought and traded their used landspeeders in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]].<ref name="Technical Journal">''[[Star Wars Technical Journal]]''</ref>

The proprietor of Spaceport Speeders was an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] called [[Unut Poll]]. [[Wioslea/Legends|Wioslea]] the [[Vuvrian/Legends|Vuvrian]] and [[Geordi Hans]] also worked there.<ref name="GG7" />

Spaceport Speeders was where [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] sold Luke's [[X-34 landspeeder/Legends|X-34 landspeeder]] before meeting with [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] at [[Docking Bay 94/Legends|Docking Bay 94]].

Shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Spaceport Speeders only had three vehicles for sale; an old [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[A-1 Deluxe Floater/Legends|A-1 Deluxe Floater]], a rebuilt [[Ubrikkian]] model, and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Luke Skywalker's landspeeder|landspeeder]] which was priced at 4,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Manhunt" />
